MEET MELODAY

A different mix.

Meloday picks from your library for the current part of the day. A fresh name, its own cover, and songs chosen around your listening.

MORE WAYS TO LISTEN

There’s more in
your library.

Find a new route through the albums you know, the songs you forgot, and the tracks you haven’t played yet.

01 / MADE FOR YOU

A good place
to press play.

Daily mixes based on what you play. Playlists for a mood or a moment. Genre Essentials refreshed every Monday.

02 / LIVE RADIO

Tune in halfway through.

Live stations keep their own time. Join mid-song, or follow Meloday Pulse’s daily programme schedule. Start radio from a song, artist, or genre when you want to choose the direction.

03 / THE MELODAY ENGINE

Let the sound lead.

The Meloday Engine analyses songs on your PC. Use Sonic Radio and Sonic Adventure to find connections by how your music sounds, without needing Plex Pass.

≋

Let songs flow.

AutoMix beat-matches songs and blends them with filter sweeps or echo-outs when the beats won’t match.

Aa

Follow every word.

Synced lyrics from Plex or LRCLIB. Adjust the timing yourself in Lyric Studio, or fill the screen with a lyric video.

▥

See what’s on repeat.

Trends shows your listening by artist, album, and song, with a calendar of the days you spent listening.

A PERSONAL PROJECT

Built for the music
you keep.

Meloday Music is made by one person, in their spare time, for their own Plex library. It grew from a daylist script into a full Windows player.

The code is open source under GPLv3. Listening history used for recommendations and Trends stays on your PC. Optional services such as Last.fm can be connected with your own account.

COMING SOON FOR WINDOWS

The public download is on its way. Meloday Music needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later (x64) and a Plex Media Server with a music library.
